tokens.name: plaster
tokens.usage: Page background — the walls of the house. Default ground for `ink`, `ink-muted`, `terracotta-ink`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Entity tiles, cards, sheets and menus that sit on `plaster`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, inputs, the track of a slider, and the fill of an entity tile that is off.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers (1px). Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control (inputs, toggles, tile outlines in high-density lists). 3:1 on `plaster` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `plaster`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, and on `lamp` fills.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: area names, timestamps, units, entity ids. Readable on `plaster`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: The Casita brand hue. Primary buttons, the selected nav item, the brand mark. Never used to mean on/off or error.

tokens.name: on-terracotta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `terracotta` fill.

tokens.name: terracotta-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and links on `plaster` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: State ON for lights and switches — the glow of a lit window. Fill of an entity tile whose device confirms it is on. Pair with `ink-on-lamp` text.

tokens.name: ink-on-lamp
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `lamp` fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: lamp-soft
tokens.usage: Brightness track behind the `lamp` level on a light slider; a dimmed light's tile edge.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Pending: a command sent but not yet confirmed by the device (outline + spinner), climate cool mode, info notices, and the keyboard focus ring. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `sky` fill.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Healthy: integration `running`, device available, lock `locked`, confirmed command. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Climate heat mode and temperature-rising accents. Not an error colour.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: integration `error`, command `failed`/`timeout`, lock `jammed`, forbidden. Always with a word and icon; close to `terracotta` in lightness, so never shown as a fill beside it.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: unavailable
tokens.usage: Hatch strokes and the dashed outline of an entity whose device is unreachable (`available: false`). Never for text; pair with the word "Unavailable" in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (clay): the measured value — room temperature, battery charge, power draw. Lines and marks only, never text; labels stay in `ink` / `ink-muted`. Validated with series-2 and series-3 as a set: colour-blind and normal-vision separation pass on every pair, 3:1 on `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (blue): the target or set point — thermostat target, charge limit — drawn as a stepped line. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (teal): a third comparison series, such as outdoor temperature. A fourth series is never a new hue: facet into a second chart.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home screen greeting and empty-state headlines. One per screen.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: The big number on a sensor or climate tile. Unit follows in `label`, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Entity names on tiles, section headings, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The front door locked at 10:42 pm.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: State summaries, buttons, form labels, units, badges.

styles.name: entity-id
styles.usage: Entity ids, device ids, MQTT topics, config paths, CLI output. Never for names a person typed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tile between name and state; between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gutter between entity tiles in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tile padding; page gutter on phones and wall tablets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between areas (rooms) on a dashboard; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; above a page title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Entity tiles, cards, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: The Casita arch: the top corners only of a tile header or window shape (`border-radius: var(--radius-arch) var(--radius-arch) 0 0`), and fully round toggles and pills.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Resting entity tiles on `plaster`.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Sheets, menus, a tile being dragged.

tokens.name: grid-unit
tokens.usage: The block everything on a page is made of: a card head, a row, a heading is one; a bigger block is n units and the gutters between them.

tokens.name: grid-step
tokens.usage: The gutter: between cards, between the blocks in a card, and a card's side padding.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: A unit and a gutter: from the top of one block to the top of the next. A block of n units is n pitches less a gutter.
